posts.content:
🚀 Excited to Share: VolunTrack – My Latest Flutter App!
Last to last week, our college hosted HackCelestial 2.0, and I had the opportunity to build an app that truly makes a difference for event volunteers – VolunTrack!
The idea was simple: make tracking participant entries (check-ins & check-outs) effortless. While initially designed for event attendance, the app is flexible enough to create and manage events of any kind.
A huge shoutout to my friend, who played a pivotal role in building the admin dashboard, while I focused on developing the mobile app in Flutter. 💻✨
🌟 Features of VolunTrack:
Event Management – Add & manage multiple events with ease.
QR Code Generation – Unique codes for each participant.
QR Scanning – Volunteers can quickly log entries.
Efficient Workflow – Minimizes manual work & speeds up check-ins.
📌 Tech Stack: Flutter (Dart) | Node.js | Supabase
💡 How It Works:
1️⃣ Create an event
2️⃣ Generate unique participant QR codes
3️⃣ Scan QR codes at the venue
4️⃣ Track all entries seamlessly
